rustCard.headline: Coffee leaf rust: clean up and prune
doNow: Check the underside of lower leaves often. Catching it early matters most.
Pick off and burn or bury leaves and branches with orange spots.
Prune and thin shade and weeds so air moves and leaves dry faster.
Feed the trees with manure or balanced fertilizer. Weak trees get hit harder.
For new planting, ask your extension officer about rust-resistant varieties such as Catimor or Sarchimor types.
whatElseCouldItBe: Coffee berry disease: look at the berries for dark sunken patches.
Coffee berry borer: look for small holes in the berries.
Coffee wilt: whole branches wilting and dying.
Poor soil or nutrition: yellowing across the whole tree.

rustDecisionLine: Decision: prune and clean up. Check again in 7 days.
